To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
there are many online educational resources for EM, but they are not always easy to find or evaluate.
the most popular FOAM websites can be found using the most popular free online search engines.
there are four strategies for emergency medicine (EM) residents to use to effectively find, evaluate, engage with, and contribute to the online resources available in EM.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how to use the vast and growing online educational resources in a way that is efficient and effective.
the development of an effective and efficient method to identify and evaluate the quality of online resources for emergency physicians.
understanding the nature of online learning in emergency medicine, with the aim of helping learners and educators to make better use of online educational resources.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the best way to learn from the online resources in emergency care is to cultivate digital mentors, to browse the most popular free online open access medical education websites, to use critical appraisal tools developed by the FOAM community, and to contribute new online content.

the best way to find, evaluate and engage with online educational resources in emergency medicine is to cultivate digital mentors, use critical appraisal tools developed specifically for FOAM, use the FOAM websites that are most popular with the emergency medicine community, and contribute new content to online educational resources in the form of FOAM.
the best way to learn is to teach.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we are trying to create a new paradigm for medical education, one where we can leverage the power of the internet to create a global network of medical educators and learners who can work collaboratively to create, evaluate, and distribute the best possible education.
the FOAM movement is an exciting and rapidly expanding resource that is here to stay.
we are trying to help learners find and evaluate the best online resources, and to help them become part of the FOAM community.
The main takeaway from our work is that
learners should not rely solely on the most popular FOAM resources, but should actively seek out and evaluate new content.
learners can use online educational resources in emergency medicine to supplement their formal training, to improve their clinical skills, and to develop new skills in medical education.
the most effective way to use online educational resources is to actively engage with them.
